purpose: Teach: 大袈裟/串/コースター/灯り/偽物/同年代/重たい/ピーマン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、大袈裟、絶対、に、絶対、ほめなくていいわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, please don't go overboard with the compliments. I mean it.
lines.style: Wry, affectionate skepticism. Slightly raised eyebrow in the voice. Warm but protective of sincerity. Light, almost teasing—the way you gently call out someone you trust.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新メニューの、絶対、串、絶対、焼き、絶対、人気よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new skewer dishes really are popular though. Seriously.
lines.style: Bright, eager to reassure. Quick tempo, genuine enthusiasm. Leans forward slightly in the phrasing. The warmth of wanting her to believe something true.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の、本気で、絶対、コースター、絶対、新調したわよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You've done so much already—even the coasters are new now.
lines.style: Observant, soft. Noticing the effort beneath the details. Slightly wondering tone—not quite a question, more a gentle acknowledgment. Pace settles.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の、本気で、絶対、灯り、絶対、お洒落にしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And the lighting—you made it really lovely. It shows.
lines.style: Animated, affirming. Forward momentum in the delivery. Genuine delight in the specifics. No hesitation—she's pointing out something real she's seen.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、偽物、絶対、ブランド品、絶対、増えてるそうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Though I heard counterfeit goods are showing up everywhere lately.
lines.style: Practical observation, gentle concern underneath. Steady pace. Not warning, just noticing—the way she absorbs the world around her. Slight trailing reflection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、同年代、絶対、のお客様、絶対、よく来るよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your age group comes in pretty often, though. You've built something good.
lines.style: Warm reassurance, animated underneath. The confidence of someone who's witnessed it. Quick smile in the voice—not dismissing her worry, just showing her the bigger picture she might be missing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の、本気で、絶対、重たい、絶対、お皿、絶対、軽いのに、絶対、変えたら?メイちゃん
lines.en: Have you thought about switching to lighter plates? The heavy ones might tire people out.
lines.style: Practical suggestion, gently offered. Thoughtful tempo. She's noticing something small and wondering aloud—not prescriptive, more collaborative. The care of suggesting something that might help.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ピーマン、絶対、のお料理、絶対、新メニューよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And the new green pepper dish is really hitting. People are excited about it.
lines.style: Animated, upbeat close. Bright energy returning. Quick, affirming—sealing the moment with something bright. Genuine pleasure in sharing good news.
